```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Runs every Monday at 00:00 UTC (9:00 JST)

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      SECURITY_SCAN_MODEL: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SCAN_MODEL }}
      SECURITY_SCAN_PROMPT: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SCAN_PROMPT }}
      RESEND_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
      RESEND_FROM_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL }}
      SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2 # v4.2.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4.2.1 # v4.2.1
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run security scan
        run: npx ts-node scripts/security-scan-toon.ts
```
